headline: [Deadly Blaze!] Fuel Tanker Fire on Cairo Ring Road Kills [At Least 31]
sub: Dozens of cars burnt in Giza
caption:
🔥 Deadly Blaze! Fuel Tanker Fire on Cairo Ring Road Kills At Least 31

A crash involving a fuel tanker set off a huge fire on the Ring Road in the Warraq area of Giza, part of Greater Cairo, on Wednesday evening. Egypt's Health Ministry said at least 31 people were killed and at least 21 were injured.

🔹 More than two dozen cars and motorcycles were burnt. Prosecutors' early count was 27 burnt vehicles.
🔹 Health Minister Khaled Abdel Ghaffar said the death toll is preliminary. Four injured people are in critical condition with severe burns.
🔹 Prosecutors are carrying out DNA tests to identify the victims, and the cause of the fire is still being investigated. President Abdel-Fattah el-Sisi expressed his condolences.

💬 How can cities make highways safer for fuel trucks? 👇

Sources: AP, AFP, Reuters, BBC

#GlobalEye #Egypt #Cairo #Giza #TankerFire #BreakingNews

headline: [Tragedy Deepens] Indonesia Gold Mine Flood Kills [At Least 16]
caption:
⛏️ Tragedy Deepens: Indonesia Gold Mine Flood Kills At Least 16

Rescuers have recovered at least 16 bodies from a flooded, unlicensed gold mine in the Pongkor area of Bogor, West Java, about 60 km south of Jakarta, the AP reported on Thursday. Heavy rain late on Monday made the Ciseureuh River overflow into a mine shaft about 100 metres deep.

🔹 At least 10 miners are still missing, according to West Java police. Police said that by the fourth day, finding survivors was becoming less likely.
🔹 325 rescuers are working in two shafts using ropes and water pumps. Police said 11 miners got out safely before the water came in.
🔹 State mining company PT Antam said the flood was not linked to its own Pongkor operations.

💬 Should governments do more to stop unsafe illegal mining? 👇

Sources: AP, Reuters, Al Jazeera

#GlobalEye #Indonesia #MineFlood #WestJava #Bogor
photo_needed: Indonesian search and rescue team (BASARNAS) working at the flooded mine, or the Pongkor gold mining hills in Bogor, West Java. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Historic First!] US Approves [1 Million] SpaceX Satellites for Space Data Centres
caption:
🛰️ Historic First! US Approves 1 Million SpaceX Satellites for Space Data Centres

The US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has approved SpaceX's request to launch up to 1 million satellites that will work as data centres in space. FCC Chairman Brendan Carr announced the decision on Wednesday, calling it "a historic first".

🔹 The satellites are "orbital compute modules": computers in space that will run AI and connect with other satellites, including SpaceX's Starlink network.
🔹 SpaceX first asked the FCC for approval in January. In its filings, the company said it could start launching the AI computing satellites as early as 2028.
🔹 Elon Musk replied to Carr: "Much appreciated. This will be a great asset to America and the world."

💬 Would you trust data centres in space? 👇

Sources: CBS News, NBC News, Newsweek

#GlobalEye #SpaceX #ElonMusk #FCC #AI #Satellites
photo_needed: SpaceX Starship rocket or a Starlink satellite in space, or Elon Musk with SpaceX logo (face clearly visible). A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Huge Blast!] Explosion at Bangkok Oil Refinery Injures [At Least 9]
sub: Fire put out within an hour
caption:
💥 Huge Blast! Explosion at Bangkok Oil Refinery Injures At Least 9

An explosion and fire hit the Bangchak oil refinery in the Phra Khanong area of eastern Bangkok, Thailand, at around 3 pm local time on Thursday. Thai authorities said at least 9 people were injured, 3 of them critically. No deaths have been reported.

🔹 Most of the injured had burns, according to Bangkok's Erawan Medical Center. Nearby residents and students from local schools were told to leave the area for a short time.
🔹 Bangchak said the fire was brought under control within about 30 minutes and all production was stopped. The cause is still under investigation.
🔹 Energy Minister Akanat Promphan said the fire seemed to start at a refinery unit about 100 metres from the oil storage, and air and water tests showed no problems. The refinery can handle 120,000 barrels a day and is the only one in Thailand inside a city.

💬 Should big oil refineries be allowed inside cities? 👇

Sources: AP, AFP, Al Jazeera

#GlobalEye #Bangkok #Thailand #Bangchak #Explosion #Refinery
photo_needed: The Bangchak oil refinery in Phra Khanong, Bangkok, with the fire or smoke (26 Nov), or firefighters at the site. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.
